shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json; find src -type f | head -50; cat index.html; cat src/* 2>/dev/null | head -200'

/bin/bash -lc "grep -o 'withTableSorting\\|export .*Pagination\\|declare function Pagination\\|interface PaginationProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/esm/index.d.ts | sort -u | head -20; sed -n '/interface PaginationProps/,/"'^}/p'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/esm/components/Pagination -name '*.d.ts' | head"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; grep -n 'Pagination' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -l 'withTableSorting' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'interface PaginationProps|type PaginationProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts"
